rawFindings.title: Parser initialization incorrectly moved into RedisClient constructor instead of create_stream
rawFindings.explanation: The RedisClient constructor was changed to initialize the reply_parser by calling create_parser(this) within the constructor, while the create_stream method had its parser initialization (this.reply_parser = create_parser(this);) removed. This breaks the expected behavior where the parser is reset each time create_stream is called, for example on reconnects. As a result, the parser is initialized only once and not reset on reconnections, which can cause parser state corruption or stale state aft
rawFindings.suggestion: Move the parser initialization line (this.reply_parser = create_parser(this)) back into the create_stream method and remove it from the RedisClient constructor to ensure the parser is freshly created whenever a stream is created or recreated.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: On reconnect, the parser is not reset and continues using stale internal state, potentially causing corrupted command parsing or failed executions after reconnecting to the Redis server.
